description: Horaires théoriques et temps-réel du réseau Lulu en Bus (Ex LUNEO) (GTFS / GTFS-RT) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Lulu en Bus (Ex. Lunéo). Three urban lines to connect the city center of Lunéville to Jolivet, Chanteheux and Moncel-lès-Lunéville. A €1.10 ride, all-day schedules, and real-time tracking. Official timetables are available on Lulu by Bus website (Ex. Luneo). Coverage: Lulu en Bus (Ex. Lunéo). The portal shows the English title as "Theoretical and real-time timetables of the Lulu bus network (Ex LUNEO) (GTFS / GTFS-RT)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Lulu en Bus (Ex. Lunéo). Its keywords include siri, transdev, temps-officiel. The listing shows 2 download or service links in GTFS, GTFS-RT. The listing shows 2026-05-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
